description: Independent web sources confirming Brazilian IMO participants + results, per edition.

provenanceClasses.official: imo-official.org — the IMO's own results database.
provenanceClasses.primary: Genuinely independent reporting naming Brazilian competitors + results (OBM/SBM/IMPA/ABC/FAPESP/gov/university/news/CVs/biographies).
provenanceClasses.archive: Third-party IMO result mirrors (polyomino.org.uk, math.olympiaadid.ut.ee, olimpiadascientificas.org) — name the roster but likely derive from official IMO data.
provenanceClasses.counts: Independent domain corroborating medal COUNTS only, no names (pt.wikipedia). Supporting.
